The exact iff classification and sharp Wieferich-square obstruction completely determine when this algebra remembers its finite abelian group, with nonisomorphic quandles whose algebras coincide at p=1093; this is a structural inverse theorem rather than an arbitrary finite computation. The full automorphism order is a further uniform intrinsic invariant.
